selected_script.angle: Preventing the chaotic domino effect of stacked cleaning tools in tight laundry room corners
selected_script.hook: POV: You just wanted to grab the broom, but the entire pile collapsed on your feet.

video_001_part_01.visual: 0-3s: Handheld shot of a cluttered laundry room corner where a hand pulls a mop, causing a broom and dustpan to slide and crash down in a pile. 3-6s: The camera moves to a clean light-gray tiled wall showing the light gray wall-mounted organizer. A hand easily pushes a broom handle into the center white silicone roller clip. 6-10s: Close-up of a wet mop handle being snapped into the end rounded capsule section, instantly securing it.
video_001_part_01.audio: No more chaotic mess. Get instant organization.

video_001_part_02.visual: 0-4s: Close-up of a small cleaning brush hanging from one of the five gray J-hooks beneath the organizer. 4-8s: The camera pans back to reveal the complete horizontal organizer holding three upright cleaning tools and small hanging accessories, leaving the floor below entirely clear. 8-10s: Gentle camera movement showcasing the clean tiled laundry wall with a text overlay.
video_001_part_02.audio: Keep your tools in reach. Clear the clutter today.
